title: Counting unit directions with density at least 1 via disjoint thin cones (parent step 5)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ be a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^P such that μ(λW) = λ·μ(W) for every λ > 0 and every open W ⊆ ℝ^P (where λW := {λx : x ∈ W}), and μ(B_1(0)) < ∞. Let T be a finite set of unit vectors of ℝ^P such that, for each σ ∈ T, ρ ≤ μ(B_ρ(σ)) holds for all sufficiently small ρ > 0 (eventually as ρ ↓ 0). Then #T ≤ 2·μ(B_1(0)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal lam * μ W) → μ (ball (0 : Euclid P) 1) ≠ ∞ → ∀ T : Finset (Euclid P), (∀ σ ∈ T, ‖σ‖ = 1) → (∀ σ ∈ T, ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal ρ ≤ μ (ball σ ρ)) → (T.card : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * μ (ball 0 1)
